clf-avc-241.text: A Solution Architect was hired by a fintech to design a highly available Big Data environment. During the infrastructure modelling process using the AWS Pricing Calculator, the engineer needs to fraction the theoretical final estimate of prices to present the costs segregated in a clean way per cost center (e.g. display the partial value of the Marketing area separated from the HR area). What native functionality of the calculator allows to organize the services in named independent structures?
options: Tables of conformity of the AWS Artifact.
clf-avc-241.explanation: The AWS Pricing Calculator allows you to create 'Groups' to organize and consolidate service estimates. The architect can add instances, banks and storages within groups named by department, generating reports of subtotals and clean partial invoices.
clf-avc-241.hint: Consider the common term in logical interfaces used to group and assemble similar components under the same structured organizational folder or label.
optionRationales: The AWS Pricing Calculator allows you to create 'Groups' to organize and consolidate service estimates. The architect can add instances, banks and storages within groups named by department, generating reports of subtotals and clean partial invoices.
Organisational Units (OUs) are part of the AWS Organizations to manage identities and active real accounts under hierarchical trees, not being internal web calculator simulation resources.
The AWS Artifact store audit reports and static international security reports of the company AWS for institutional download, lacking functional engines of financial mathematics or calculators.
SCPs define mandatory maximum permissions guards in the AWS Organizations and have no legal or technical involvement with web tools of theoretical price estimates.

clf-avc-242.text: A large retail network adopts the AWS Organizations to centralize the governance of its 30 e-commerce subsidiaries. In the monthly fiscal closure, the finance team of the main paying account (Management Account) issues a single consolidated billing containing the unified costs of all associated member accounts. Under the perspective of legal and financial accounting responsibility for consolidated billing, which alternative correctly describes a rule of this model?
options: Each daughter member account continues to receive separate invoices via e-mail and must pay its own taxes in an isolated and disconnected way..
The main paying account assumes full responsibility for the financial billing and discharge of aggregate consumption values of the entire cluster of associated accounts in the organisation.
The activation of consolidated billing delegates credit card bonds and charges entirely to the technical support team of the AWS Marketplace.
Consolidated invoicing obliges AWS synchronously convert all instances on demand into free t2.micro virtual machines.
clf-avc-242.explanation: In the consolidated invoicing AWS Organizations, the account payment (Management Account) is legally responsible for paying the unified monthly invoice that adds up the expenses of all linked accounts (Linked Accounts), centralizing corporate accounting.
clf-avc-242.hint: Remember that the role of the 'mother' account or principal payer in the hierarchical tree of Organizations it is centralizing cash flows and assuming unified tax control of the holding.
optionRationales: In the consolidated invoicing AWS Organizations, the account payment (Management Account) is legally responsible for paying the unified monthly invoice that adds up the expenses of all linked accounts (Linked Accounts), centralizing corporate accounting.
Marketplace operates by managing licenses and purchases of third-party software and does not assume liability for invoices or debt write-offs or infrastructure costs of customers of the AWS.
Consolidated invoicing extinguishes the issue of separate invoicing by subsidiary and concentrates all licit consumption charges on a single standardized central account.
Accounting consolidation unifies collection, but does not mechanically change the logical configurations of families or hardware sizings created by engineers.
